title: Correct the joint-law/marginal and hazard dependence in the wall audit
problem: Block73 defines W4 as the actual atomic joint append/refusal/locking map but then says W3/W4 and W4/W5 imply neither direction. A fixed normalized full map determines its own conditional marginals and per-step event mass. Saying another joint map can have different marginals, or the conditional append map can run at another hazard, changes the object whose closure is being counted. The all-55-pairs independence conclusion is therefore unsupported at this declared integrated scope.
fix: Record the actual forward dependencies from the full instrument to its represented marginals and hazard, while retaining the reverse nonuniqueness and off-domain/physical-time/selection gaps. Alternatively redefine the conditional append contract explicitly and do not call it the full refusal instrument. Narrow the all-independent count; other unresolved directions should remain unresolved without a valid witness. Preserve all positive conditional constructions and viable alternatives. This is a partial-dependence/atomization correction, not a claim that a one-event map closes all off-domain Admissibility values or global scheduling: different fallback support measures, opportunity selectors and physical-time data remain open. Reuse the existing same-alpha/different-hazard and same-hazard/different-alpha examples only for their correctly typed components.
control: Independent exact joint law with empty mass 2/3 has forced occurrence mass 1/3 and conditional bit marginal (1/2,1/2). Marginals still do not determine the coupling, and the finite joint law does not select physical time, realization or a global extension.
